name: Low bramble patch
description: A low patch of brambles about 1 × 1 m and 0.6 m high: a mound of dark bramble leaves over a dark tangle, purple-red thorny canes arching out over the rim and rooting their tips in the ground, a dead grey cane or two, ripe and unripe blackberries and a few pale blossoms.

provenance.prompt: A low bramble patch, about 1 × 1 × 0.6 m.
